mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_webhook_inbox ( platform_type, source_event_id, event_type, external_order_id, payload_json, raw_body_sha256, status ) VALUES ( #{platformType}, #{sourceEventId}, #{eventType}, #{externalOrderId}, #{payloadJson}, #{rawBodySha256}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform_type, source_event_id, event_type, external_order_id, payload_json, raw_body_sha256, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, claimed_by, claimed_until, claim_version, requeue_count, last_requeued_at, received_at, processed_at, last_error_code, last_error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM provider_webhook_inbox WHERE platform_type = #{platformType} AND source_event_id = #{sourceEventId}

SELECT id, platform_type, source_event_id, event_type, external_order_id, payload_json, raw_body_sha256, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, claimed_by, claimed_until, claim_version, requeue_count, last_requeued_at, received_at, processed_at, last_error_code, last_error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM provider_webhook_inbox WHERE status = 'BLOCKED' AND last_error_code IN ( 'PLATFORM_MENU_MAPPING_NOT_FOUND', 'PLATFORM_MENU_NOT_ORDERABLE' ) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, platform_type, source_event_id, event_type, external_order_id, payload_json, raw_body_sha256, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, claimed_by, claimed_until, claim_version, requeue_count, last_requeued_at, received_at, processed_at, last_error_code, last_error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM provider_webhook_inbox WHERE ( status = 'RECEIVED'
OR ( status = 'RETRYABLE_FAILED' AND ( next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) )
OR ( status = 'PROCESSING' AND claimed_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_webhook_inbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', claimed_by = #{workerId}, claimed_until = TIMESTAMPADD( SECOND, #{leaseSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ), claim_version = claim_version + 1, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND claim_version = #{expectedClaimVersion}

UPDATE provider_webhook_inbox SET status = 'PROCESSED', processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), claimed_by = NULL, claimed_until = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND claimed_by = #{workerId} AND claim_version = #{claimVersion} AND claimed_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE provider_webhook_inbox SET status = 'RECEIVED', retry_count = 0, next_retry_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), claimed_by = NULL, claimed_until = NULL, requeue_count = requeue_count + 1, last_requeued_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'BLOCKED'

UPDATE provider_webhook_inbox SET status = 'RECEIVED', retry_count = 0, next_retry_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), claimed_by = NULL, claimed_until = NULL, requeue_count = requeue_count + 1, last_requeued_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE status = 'BLOCKED' AND last_error_code IN ('PLATFORM_MENU_MAPPING_NOT_FOUND', 'PLATFORM_MENU_NOT_ORDERABLE')
